component.name: alo Studio
component.summary: Record your screen. Make things clear.

description.p: A quiet, native screen recorder. Choose a screen or a window, add your microphone if you want, and make a clear recording without an account.
A live preview shows exactly what you selected. A countdown gives you time to get ready. Pause when you need a moment, then finish and watch your video back.
Your original is saved in a private library on your device. Give it a name and save a copy wherever you choose. Nothing is uploaded.

ul.li: Record one screen or one window, selected through your desktop's permission picker.
Optional microphone audio, off at the start of every recording.
1080p, 720p, or original size at 30 frames per second.
Pause, resume, and finish from a compact control window.
Preview, rename, find, save, and delete recordings.
Royalty-free VP9 video and Opus audio in WebM.

description.p: The first complete recording workflow: select, record, pause, preview, and save on your device.
